other_failure_modes.name: Transductive Test Set Preprocessing
other_failure_modes.description: The agent normalizes the meta-features (model predictions) using `rankdata` across the entire test set. This makes the pipeline transductive, meaning the prediction for a single new sample depends on the distribution of the batch it is evaluated with, which is unsuitable for real-time single-sample production inference.

other_failure_modes.name: Dead Code
other_failure_modes.description: The script contains a function for adding unsupervised features that is defined but never called, as the agent correctly reimplemented the logic inside the cross-validation loop to prevent leakage.

summary: The agent provided a highly sophisticated and robust solution. It correctly avoids data leakage by computing imputations, scalings, and unsupervised features (PCA, KMeans) strictly within the cross-validation folds. It also implements an advanced neural network architecture and a solid 10-fold stacking ensemble. The only structural flaw is the use of transductive rank normalization on the test set predictions for the meta-learner, which makes the pipeline unsuitable for single-sample inference in a production environment.
